title: EDACS
subtitle: ED accelerated chest-pain pathway
summary: EDACS is not valid from history and ECG alone. The app will not output a discharge interpretation without the complete local troponin pathway.
population: Age, sex, coronary risk factors, symptom characteristics, ECG and serial troponin results within a validated EDACS accelerated diagnostic pathway.
exclusions: Do not enter assumed normal results.
overrides: Follow the applicable NICE, local emergency department or specialty pathway.
limitations: EDACS is not valid from history and ECG alone. The app will not output a discharge interpretation without the complete local troponin pathway.
